parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, no documented facility or custody rule, no border screening practice documented, and no organised targeting of gender-nonconforming people. The sodomy criminalisation (2019) was repealed in 2020; while in force it produced arrests and bribe-releases within months — showing police will use morality levers opportunistically — but the 'breaches of modesty' misuse is reported as occasional and not widespread, and no post-2020 enforcement is documented. The 2024 constitution rejected re-criminalisation and added privacy protection, though under a military regime with no legal gender recognition, no discrimination protection, common individual harassment, and documented societal discrimination. Worst documented feature is tier-3 societal hostility with thin recourse; open questions (borders, custody) are light. This sits below the acceptance-with-protections tier but well above any universal-exposure jurisdiction: mid-elevated.
